Women's Shootout Tucson

Tucson, AZ · Menlo Park · Road

Women / trans / femme

Women's Shootout Tucson is a road group ride in Tucson, AZ. It rolls every Saturday at 6:15 am from Mercado San Agustín. About 30, 40 or 50 miles, road ride, cycling experience required.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: road ride, cycling experience required.
Check
Look at @womens_shootout_tucson the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Women's Shootout Tucson group ride

A women's Saturday road ride from the Mercado on Tucson's west side. Pick 30, 40 or 50 miles. Organizers ask for some road riding experience. Check the Instagram for seasonal start times.
